text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Milady over there, this way... Standing 
for an eternity must surely be wearying."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Granting peace to those who came 
before... that is what this means. Take my 
place and settle into this seat."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Um...??? Sorry 'bout that~, it's hard for 
me to understand what you young folks are 
sayin'...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I desire the harmony that 
should exist within this train car! The 
one worthy of sitting here is—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here we are, here we are... Gotta get 
off now. See ya later, little lady.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief, words can be terribly 
inadequate at times.

Unable to get her true intentions across, 
Tanino Gimlet had to explain herself over 
and over. She couldn't help showing a hint 
of exhaustion...
